snippetRequirement.requirement: Inbuilt agent tools default-on with opt-out: repowise index/query/risk, RTK token-optimized commands, terse telegraphic style, telemetry collect/report

snippetStories.userStory: As an agent I get a native local codebase index of file list, symbol table and content hashes, default-on with opt-out and zero hidden cost when off (RW-SLICE-01-index-spec.md).
As an agent I can run keyword search over the local codebase index with no network egress (RW-SLICE-02-query-spec.md).
As an agent I get change-risk, why and dependency-path answers computed over the local index (RW-SLICE-03-risk-spec.md).
As a worker I run shell commands through native inbuilt RTK core filters that cut token use with zero behavior change (RTK-SLICE-01-core-spec.md).
As a worker I get failure-only output for test, build and lint commands, default-on with opt-out (RTK-SLICE-02-test-spec.md).
As a worker I get analysis, infra and package-manager filters plus the global RTK pass, chain, proxy and opt-out contract (RTK-SLICE-03-pass-spec.md).
As a user I get terse telegraphic response rendering by default with an opt-out renderer (CV-SLICE-01-render-spec.md).
As a user I get the terse-mode auto-clarity guard so compression never hides security warnings or ordered steps (CV-SLICE-02-clarity-spec.md).
As a release auditor I get native compression-stats collection with no hidden cost when off (HR-SLICE-01-collect-spec.md).
As a release auditor I get a telemetry report renderer for session stats output (HR-SLICE-02-report-spec.md).
As a user I can opt out of all four inbuilt tools from one unified default-on settings surface (SET-SLICE-01-optout-spec.md).

As a release auditor I get four frozen research docs (RW-RES-01 repowise, RTK-RES-01 RTK, CV-RES-01 terse, HR-RES-01 telemetry) as evidence with no product code and no network egress (REL-008 research consolidation).
